structure: A corpus of 455 Playwright fit-test traces (one trace.zip per test folder, report.json maps tests to folders; 29 spec files) of the animals frontend at 4c2119da, all passed. Scope rule: every trace folder is in scope (whole-folder scope, no filter needed). The installed Playwright trace viewer rejects these zips (TraceVersionError: trace created by a newer Playwright), so `tim distil trace ... open` could not be used; instead I unzipped selected traces into the working folder and read the recorded action list (before events), the network log and the DOM frame-snapshots directly with jq, rendering the main content text. I did not open all 455 traces: I indexed all 455 test titles from report.json (index.tsv) and mined the rendered pages from one core-journey trace (journey-smoke 'the opening run carries a new notification through to the review page in one pass', 71 snapshots pages) plus targeted traces for the dashboard, hub, declaration, confirmation, delete, cancel-amend, check-answers (unfinished), and error states (origin, import-reason, CPH, commodity details, arrival date, documents upload, address picker). Journey order and conditions as rendered: dashboard (/live-animals) > Start a new notification > origin (Origin of the import) > commodities (What are you importing?) > consignment-details (Commodity details) > import-reason (Main reason for import) > commodities/identification (Identification details, only when the commodity declares identifiers) > additional-details > port-of-entry (Arrival details) > transit-countries (only on overland transport in this trace) > transporters (Transporter details; add route: type question then private or commercial form) > accompanying-documents (Upload documents) > addresses (Consignment addresses hub with place-of-origin, consignors, consignees, importers, destinations select pickers and cph-number) > consignment/contact/select (Contact address for consignment) > notification-view (Review your notification, six numbered sections) > declaration > confirmation. A hub overview page (Overview with Notification tasklist of six numbered sections) is reachable from any page. Also in scope but mined only through test titles: service navigation, page title and section caption features, delete-notification, cancel-amend, notification-actions (copy), party-edit. Page chrome (header, phase banner, footer) skipped. Server-to-server calls (backend, address book, reference data, document scan) are not visible in browser network logs, so integrations are inferred or gaps.

claims.statement: The installed Playwright trace viewer could not open these traces (TraceVersionError: the trace was created by a newer version of Playwright), so no accessibility tree, hint text via eval or component class audit was taken; rendered text was recovered from the recorded DOM frame-snapshots instead.
claims.quote: TraceVersionError: The trace was created by a newer version of Playwright and is not supported by this version of the viewer.
claims.note: A tooling problem the parent should know about; reconcile may not rely on component-class findings from this source.
